faqs.question: Should I use ✌️✨ in a complaint?
faqs.answer: ✌️✨ can punctuate a complaint-coded message but rarely fixes one. Pair with text that names the issue so the reaction-coded emoji is reinforcement, not noise.

faqs.question: What does ✌️✨ mean if I do not reply?
faqs.answer: If you do not reply to ✌️✨, the combo usually stays a benign reaction. Senders rarely escalate over an unreplied reaction-coded emoji.

faqs.question: Is ✌️✨ ever ironic?
faqs.answer: Yes — reaction-coded combos can flip ironic when paired with text that contradicts the cue. The combo does not always match the message.

faqs.question: Does ✌️✨ mean what I think?
faqs.answer: Yes — ✌️✨ rarely misreads. The two emojis together make the cue explicit enough that confusion is unusual.
